#+TITLE: Babel demo

A small Lua source block.  Press =,xb= (or =:Org babel execute=)
inside the block to run it; the result lands as =#+RESULTS:= right
below.

Lua is built into Neovim's tree-sitter, so the body highlights
without any extra parser install.

#+begin_src lua
local pow = function(b, e)
  local r = 1
  for _ = 1, e do r = r * b end
  return r
end
return pow(2, 10)
#+end_src
